## Unity Object Mapping

### Crown (Primary Focus)
- **Mesh**: Cylinder band + 6 spike cones + apex orb + 2 torus rings
- **Material**: Gold `#c99a33` metallic 0.92, emissive rim reacts to bass
- **Animation**: Scale pulse on beat, rotation in build, gold flare on drops

### Embers (Particle System)
- **Count by act**: 10 (intro) → 34 (drops) → 18 (verse) → 26 (build) → 34 (climax) → fade
- **Color**: Cool `#ff6b35` → warm `#ffd700` gradient
- **Motion**: Rise + drift, accelerate on drops

### Ground Plane
- **Material**: Dark ash `#0a0706`, metallic 0.3, roughness 0.9
- **Reflection**: Crown reflection via planar reflection or mirror shader

### Camera
- **Type**: Cinemachine virtual camera (or scripted Transform)
- **Behaviors**: Push-in on intro, beat spring on drops, orbit in build, pull-back in verse

## Unity Implementation Notes

### Beat Sync (152 BPM)
```
BEAT_FRAMES = 60/152*30 ≈ 11.8f → trigger on frame % 12
Bass gate: bass > 0.3 → crown rings scale = 1.25 + bass*0.7
```

### Materials (PBR)
- **Crown band**: `#c99a33`, metallic 0.92, roughness 0.3, emissive rim
- **Spikes**: `#e8b23c`, metallic 0.95, roughness 0.2
- **Apex orb**: `#fff3c4`, emissive 0.75 + high*0.5
- **Ground**: `#0a0706`, metallic 0.3, roughness 0.9

### Camera Script
```csharp
// Beat spring on drops
if (beatFrame % 12 == 0 && bassEnergy > 0.3f)
    camera.transform.position += Vector3.forward * 0.04f;
```

### Embers (VFX Graph or Particle System)
- **Spawn rate**: 10/sec intro → 34/sec drops
- **Velocity**: upward + drift, accelerate on drops
- **Color over life**: cool `#ff6b35` → warm `#ffd700` → fade
